sentences: That crossed-out "was" price on a Black Friday deal may be the least honest number on the page.
A graphics card that says "was 399, now 299" feels like a hundred dollars off.
Last year, the consumer group Which tracked 175 sale products from eight big retailers.
Eighty-three percent were the same price or cheaper at least once outside the sale.
Not one was at its cheapest only on Black Friday.
Check a price history tracker, like PCPartPicker or camelcamelcamel.
If it's been 299 since summer, you saved nothing.
Six more traps are in our video, 7 Black Friday PC Part Traps.
